expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-07-07. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Detained as a juvenile and held at Parchman following the July 1961 Jackson arrest. Returned to his mother in July 1961. Accounts disagree about the number of days held; a 2026 interview-based report dates release to July 13, while other accounts report three, five or eleven days. Release is recorded at month precision pending reconciliation with the original juvenile-court or prison record. No exact served total is inferred.

entries.rationale: MDAH arrest documentation and the Orlando municipal speaker biography support July 7, 1961 custody. Interviews establish Parchman confinement and release that July. Conflicting duration accounts and the July 6 arrest date in the 2026 report prevent treating its July 13 release as independently reconciled; retain month precision and no exact total.
